mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_employee (shop_id, username, password, avatar_url, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{username}, #{password}, #{avatarUrl}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: select id, shop_id, username, password, avatar_url, last_login_time, login_count, status, created_at, updated_at from tb_employee where shop_id=#{shopId} and username=#{username}
select id, shop_id, username, password, avatar_url, last_login_time, login_count, status, created_at, updated_at from tb_employee where id=#{id}
mapper.update: update tb_employee set last_login_time = datetime('now', 'localtime'), login_count = #{loginCount}, updated_at = datetime('now', 'localtime') where id = #{id}
